caption: Government Employees Insurance Co. v. Koppel
citation_line: Government Employees Insurance Co. v. Koppel, No. 2:21-cv-03413, ECF No. 159 (D.N.J. Aug. 28, 2023)
headnote_district_ruling: Denied physicians' effort to quash a subpoena to New Jersey's Office of the Insurance Fraud Prosecutor in a civil RICO and insurance-fraud case, finding the responsive records relevant and not privileged while permitting confidentiality designations.
qualification_rationale: Practical guidance on party standing, statutory confidentiality, burden, and protective-order treatment for law-enforcement records sought in parallel civil fraud litigation.
appellate_posture_note: Non-dispositive discovery order; no substantive appellate review identified.
subject_screen_exclusion_reason: Third-party subpoena and confidentiality ruling in insurance-fraud litigation.
